source_scope: Eight already exposed development clusters; read density, errors and enclosed stellar mass only. Parent container also contains previously exposed pressure, not used in this source audit.
width_role: Fixed source reconstruction nuisance. Gaussian convolution of dM/dlog(r), not a fitted gravity length or a velocity/pressure-selected smoothing width.
outer_closure: Gas density continues its last measured logarithmic slope to twice the last measured source radius, then the unsmoothed enclosed mass is constant. Gaussian smoothing conserves this finite source mass. The unmeasured continuation is a declared source assumption.
core: Inherited constant-density inner core, smoothed consistently. Integration starts at first source radius divided by 100, far below every evaluated probe.

source_fidelity.sensitivity_cases: Retain all source deviations descriptively; a source discrepancy is not a gravity rejection.

adaptation: The source-only predecessor exceeded its fixed 2 percent stellar-mass fidelity limit at two A85 source knots. Narrow the common smoothing width and scale numerical resolution accordingly; no pressure outcome has been predicted or used, and no tolerance is relaxed.
